```{python}
#| label: fig-sim-analysis-overview
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Family tree of circuit simulation analyses. Every analysis starts from the dc operating point. The small-signal analyses linearize around a constant operating point (LTI) or around a periodic steady state (LPTV). The periodic steady state is found either in the time domain (shooting PSS) or in the frequency domain (harmonic balance, HB). The fundamental analyses are shown in blue, the advanced RF analyses in orange."
import schemdraw as sd
from schemdraw import flow

sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

blue = '#dbe8f6'
orange = '#fde3c8'

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(fontsize=13, unit=1, margin=0.3)

    op = flow.RoundBox(w=5.0, h=1.3).at((8.5, 0)).anchor('center').fill(blue) \
        .label('op, dc\ndc operating point')

    # second row: what is done with the operating point
    ss = flow.Box(w=4.2, h=1.6).at((1.5, -3.2)).anchor('center').fill(blue) \
        .label('ac, acsp, noise\nsmall signal, LTI')
    tr = flow.Box(w=3.6, h=1.6).at((6.4, -3.2)).anchor('center').fill(blue) \
        .label('tran\nlarge signal')
    pss = flow.Box(w=3.6, h=1.6).at((10.6, -3.2)).anchor('center').fill(orange) \
        .label('PSS\nshooting')
    hb = flow.Box(w=3.6, h=1.6).at((14.8, -3.2)).anchor('center').fill(orange) \
        .label('HB\nharmonic balance')

    # third row: derived analyses
    trn = flow.Box(w=3.6, h=1.6).at((6.4, -6.4)).anchor('center').fill(orange) \
        .label('transient\nnoise')
    pac = flow.Box(w=3.6, h=1.6).at((10.6, -6.4)).anchor('center').fill(orange) \
        .label('PAC, PNOISE\nsmall signal, LPTV')
    hbac = flow.Box(w=3.6, h=1.6).at((14.8, -6.4)).anchor('center').fill(orange) \
        .label('HBAC, HBNOISE\nsmall signal, LPTV')

    for b in (ss, tr, pss, hb):
        flow.Arrow().at(op.S).to(b.N)
    flow.Arrow().at(tr.S).to(trn.N)
    flow.Arrow().at(pss.S).to(pac.N)
    flow.Arrow().at(hb.S).to(hbac.N)

    # arrow annotations, placed next to the vertical arrows
    for x, txt in ((6.4, '+ device noise'), (10.6, 'linearize'), (14.8, 'linearize')):
        sd.elements.Label().at((x + 0.15, -4.8)).label(txt, fontsize=11, halign='left', color='gray')
```
